simple.meaning: שַׁחֲרוּת (shachărûwth) is a Hebrew word meaning “a dawning , i.e. (figuratively) juvenescence.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H7839. shacharuth שַׁחֲרוּת noun feminine according to DE Comm . Rüetschi Kau blackness , namely, of hair (so ᵑ7 ), i.e. (RV) prime of life (which Wild allows); usually dawn of youth (II. שׁחר ); — Eccl 11:10 (+ יַלְדוּת ).
